mode.description: Operation mode: 'e' for encrypt (source unencrypted, target encrypted) or 'd' for decrypt.

source_socket.description: Unix socket path or host:port on which spiped listens for incoming connections.

target_socket.description: Unix socket path or host:port to which spiped connects.

key_file.description: Path to the symmetric key file used for authentication and encryption.

bind_address.description: Outbound bind address (IP or IP:port). Leave empty to let OS choose.

run_foreground.description: If true, run in foreground (-F). If false, daemonize.

fast_handshake.description: If true, disable Diffie-Hellman handshake for speed (-f). Loses perfect forward secrecy.

perfect_forward_secrecy.description: If true, drop connections if peer uses fast handshake (-g). Requires perfect forward secrecy.

pid_file.description: Path to write PID file. Leave empty if not needed or if running in foreground.

resolve_interval.description: Interval in seconds to re-resolve target socket DNS. 0 to disable re-resolution.

use_syslog.description: If true, send warnings to syslog after daemonizing (--syslog).

user.description: Username to drop privileges to after binding socket.

group.description: Group name to drop privileges to after binding socket.
